reviews.review:
[h3]not necessarily a bad review[/h3], it's a great game. I had plenty of fun driving around in the single player campaign, the controls are easy to grasp (except flying) and feel good (again, except for flying. if a game requires use of the numpad they're doing something terribly wrong and it's time to rethink). and while I had a great time in the single player campaign, that's just the thing, I could only play the [b]single player campaign[/b]. Rockstar Launcher had a problem seemingly only I encountered, I was locked to offline mode with no option of going online (despite having a rockstar account, which I made specifically for this) and any attempt to go online was interrupted by the log in screen disappearing a few seconds after showing up. no amount of googling fixed this issue, as again I'd seemingly been the only one to experience the launcher refusing to go online (my ethernet connection was plenty good enough, btw)

Online:
rotating heists with the boys at a crisp 3am on a friday, dealing with whiney greifers or just messing around man what a peak experience i really hope GTA 6 has the same charm as this one did because nothing beats a week or 2 grind every few weeks on this game with your group. when GTA 6 comes out ill be a little sad that the online won't be as active anymore (or shut down im not sure if there gonna do both) however if gta 6 online is anything like this with better newer graphics and visuals man sign me up.

Story:
a FANASTIC story game, with comical ass characters (ahem trevor) you can see why its one of the best selling games of oat alone it ticks off so many boxes for a game its unreal, if you haven't picked it up im a little shocked the story is worth a once over before GTA 6.
